## Summary

A short description of the feature you would like to see.

## Motivation

Why is this feature useful? What problem does it solve or what workflow does it
improve?

## Proposed solution

Describe how you think this could be implemented. Include any CLI flags,
configuration options, or behaviour changes you have in mind. Pseudocode or
shell examples are welcome.
